identity.reference_content_digest_reason: the sealed bundle is not authored by this packet and must not be, so a content digest quoted here would be fabricated. It is bound at seal time by whoever mints the bundle.

mirror_assertion: this spec .identity block equals swarm.evals.g13_sealed_reference.interface_identity(), asserted by tests/evals/test_task_pool_freeze_v2.py

closes_v1_blocker.blocker: B2 - expected_output, grader, reference_solution and broken_code sat in plaintext inside benchmarks/starter.jsonl, so any worker with repository read access could read the held-out answers
closes_v1_blocker.how: a v2 record has no field in which an answer, grader fixture, rubric or answer digest could sit. It carries only an opaque surrogate key and an interface version, and the resolver has no default source and no local fallback path.

what_the_worker_can_learn_from_a_hidden_: that a sealed reference exists for this case
its index in the bundle's own ordering
what_the_worker_cannot_learn: any digest of the reference content
whether two cases share a reference
seal_time_obligations: the bundle must quote the commitment digest of SEALED_REFERENCE_IDS.txt as frozen by this manifest
the bundle must hold exactly 240 entries, one per opaque id, with no extra and no missing id
the bundle must live outside the worker-visible branch and must never be committed to it
the bundle's content digest must be bound before any counted qualification run; until then the freeze verifier computes counted_qualification_ready = false
